**Static class** in the `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Windows](/docs/reference/#latiprimerewindows) package.

```csharp
public static class LatiprimereWindowsServiceCollectionExtensions
```

Registers the Windows print system with a dependency injection container.

## Methods

### AddLatiprimereWindows

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddLatiprimereWindows(this IServiceCollection services, Action<WindowsOptions>? configure = null)
```

Registers the Windows print system. Use together with `AddLatiprimere()` from the Latiprimere package, and `AddLatiprimerePdfium()` from Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium to print PDF documents. Safe to call on every platform: elsewhere the print system reports itself as unsupported and is ignored.

**Parameters**

- `services`: The service collection to add to.
- `configure`: Configures how to print, or `null` for the defaults.

**Returns**

The same service collection, for chaining.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `services` is `null`.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): On Windows with [WindowsOptions.PrintPdfOverIpp](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/windowsoptions/#printpdfoveripp) on, a URI in [WindowsOptions.IppPrinterUris](/docs/reference/latiprimere-windows/windowsoptions/#ippprinteruris) isn't an absolute ipp, ipps, http or https URI.
